title: Give a clear error reply
summary: Fastify: Give a clear error reply. Inspect the 500 status.
introduction: setErrorHandler handles errors from routes. GET /broken returns a simple public message.
learningObjectives: Give a clear error reply with Fastify

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Give a clear error reply

blocks.text: The thrown error reaches the configured handler, which sends status 500 and a short message.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Avoid showing private stack traces to clients.

seo.title: Fastify: Give a clear error reply
seo.description: Fastify: Give a clear error reply. Inspect the 500 status. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
